author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
BIG NEWS - Warner Bros has announced that Stephen Colbert will be writing a new Middle-earth film currently titled "The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past."  We gotta chat about this!

Synopsis:
Fourteen years after the passing of Frodo, Sam, Merry, and Pippin set out to retrace the first steps of their adventure. Meanwhile, Sam’s daughter, Elanor, has discovered a long-buried secret and is determined to uncover why the War of the Ring was very nearly lost before it even began.
title: Stephen Colbert writing LOTR sequel, Shadow of the Past!
